name: 020-chat-sampled-temp07
description: Sampled chat-completions with temperature=0.7 and a fixed seed. Asserts that the same (seed, prompt, params) deterministically produces the same top-1 first-token id and the same final string.

messages.content: Give me one playful three-word phrase about cats.

determinism_check.notes: Issue the identical request twice; the assistant string must be byte-identical across runs (verifies seed plumbing + deterministic sampler). Recorded golden string lives in `ref_outputs.first_token_id` once the real model is wired.

ref_outputs.notes: When NvEngineChat is wired with the real Qwen3 4B instruct weights, fill `first_token_id` and `final_content` with the values produced under seed=1337, temp=0.7, top_p=0.9. The assertion at that point is exact-match on `final_content` and `first_token_id` from the first streamed delta.
